services.heading: Audiovisual Services
services.sub: We cover the full production cycle — concept to distribution — and also operate as specialist technicians at live events.
services.s1desc: Institutional videos, brand presentations, content for social networks and digital platforms. We communicate your company's identity with precision.
services.s2desc: Short films and fiction projects aimed at national and international festivals. Executive production and department management.
services.s3desc: Corporate, product, event and portrait photography. Images that communicate before a single word is read.
services.s4desc: Video editing, color grading, motion graphics, sound mixing and VFX. The final touch that makes the difference.

about.heading: Art without expressive barriers
about.lead: Masala Studios was born with a utopian vision: to create art without creative or geographic limits. The name says it all — masala, in Hindi, means 'a mixture of spices'.
about.body: We believe that beyond impacting those who see a work today, it is possible to create a faithful portrait of reality that can be recovered and studied in the future, like an archaeological find.
